intro: Receive Stripe test webhooks on a local FlyEnv site. No public domain or tunnel is required.
installFirst: Install a Stripe CLI version from Version Manager, then connect your account.
loginHelp: Connect in your browser and select your Stripe account or sandbox. Stripe CLI manages your credentials; FlyEnv does not ask for your password. Stop the listener before changing accounts.
pairingCodeHelp: Compare this code with Stripe's browser page. Confirm there only if they match. Waiting for approval for up to 10 minutes.
pairingEnded: This connection attempt has ended. Connect again for a new code; do not approve the old browser page.
urlHelp: Select a site suggestion or enter its complete webhook URL. Replace /stripe/webhook with your application's actual route, and keep its local web server running.
eventsHelp: Leave empty to receive all snapshot events. Uses Stripe test mode / sandbox; live events are not enabled.
skipVerify: Allow an untrusted local HTTPS certificate
secretHelp: Use this CLI signing secret in your local application's webhook configuration. Dashboard webhook endpoints have separate secrets.
noEvents: Start the listener, then make a Stripe test payment to see webhook delivery results here.
timeout: Stripe operation timed out. Check the service status before retrying.
loginPending: Finish connecting your Stripe account before starting the listener.
loginPrecondition: Select an installed Stripe CLI version and stop the listener before connecting an account.
installFailed: Stripe CLI installation failed. Check your connection and try again.
testDataHelp: Create Stripe test products, prices, customers and subscriptions using the same account as the listener. These are test objects, not live billing. Keep the listener running to observe the resulting webhooks.
subscriptionHelp: Subscriptions use default_incomplete payment behavior. Stripe may return incomplete until a payment method is added and the first invoice is paid. This form uses test mode; no live charge is created.
creationRetryHelp: A failed response can leave the result unknown. Check Stripe before changing fields or restarting. Retrying unchanged input in this session reuses the same idempotency key.
moreResources: Showing the first 25 objects. Use Stripe CLI for further pages.
finishDataAction: Finish the current test-data action before changing accounts.
selectCLI: Select an installed Stripe CLI version first.
sampleHelp: Choose a fixture to create test objects and events in Stripe. Some fixtures also generate related events. Start the listener and check its delivery log to confirm local receipt.
sampleSent: Stripe created the sample event. Check the delivery log for receipt.
